data.title: 吹雪 · 暴雪组的白色誓约
data.description: 吹雪穿着祖母绿与白色相间的礼服婚纱，站在盛放白玫瑰的温室中央；她一手整理珍珠项链，一手接过捧花，微笑从领导者的完美弧度变成只给镜头的轻微羞赧。
data.action: 白玫瑰温室里接过捧花整理珍珠项链，领导者微笑变成轻微羞赧
data.lighting: green-gold evening light through the glass roof
data.mood: 体面铠甲下的私人誓约
data.promptProse: She adjusts her pearls with one hand and accepts the bouquet from the viewer with the other; green-gold light through the greenhouse roof softens her shy smile among the white roses.
data.animaCaption: One hand adjusts her pearls while the other accepts the bouquet from the viewer.
